import numpy as np
import seaborn as sns
from matplotlib import pyplot as plt


def task_func(P, T):
    """
    Multiply a 2D matrix P by a 3D tensor T using NumPy and visualize the result
    as a heatmap.

    Parameters
    ----------
    P : numpy.ndarray or numpy.matrix
        2D matrix.
    T : numpy.ndarray or numpy.matrix
        3D tensor whose first dimension matches P.shape[1].

    Returns
    -------
    numpy.ndarray
        Result of the matrix-tensor product with shape (P.shape[0], T.shape[1], T.shape[2]).
    matplotlib.axes.Axes
        Axes object containing the heatmap of a 2D view of the product.
    """
    if not isinstance(P, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(T, np.ndarray):
        raise TypeError("P and T must be numpy arrays or numpy matrices.")

    P = np.asarray(P)
    T = np.asarray(T)

    if P.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("P must be a 2D matrix.")
    if T.ndim != 3:
        raise ValueError("T must be a 3D tensor.")
    if P.shape[1] != T.shape[0]:
        raise ValueError(
            "Incompatible shapes: P.shape[1] must equal T.shape[0] for multiplication."
        )
    if P.size == 0 or T.size == 0:
        raise ValueError("P and T must be non-empty.")

    # Matrix-tensor product over the shared dimension.
    product = np.tensordot(P, T, axes=([1], [0]))

    # Convert the product into a 2D representation for visualization.
    if product.ndim == 2:
        heatmap_data = product
    else:
        rows = product.shape[0]
        cols = 0 if product.size == 0 else product.size // rows
        heatmap_data = product.reshape(rows, cols)

    if np.iscomplexobj(heatmap_data):
        heatmap_data = np.abs(heatmap_data)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 6))
    sns.heatmap(heatmap_data, ax=ax, cmap="viridis")
    ax.set_title("Matrix-Tensor Product Heatmap")
    ax.set_xlabel("Flattened tensor dimension")
    ax.set_ylabel("Matrix row dimension")

    return product, ax
